comments.author: TheMutedBalaclava
comments.body_html:
UPDATE: found the problem! And we all know who’s fault is? Yeah, myself! And my dumdum thick skull was thinking it wasnt a skinned problem as very rightfully Fontaine said.

Ok, explanation: Im using Moxopixel’s TGC and there is 3 BCM foregrip variants with the mod (standard GFmod3, GFmod3 (reverse) and GFmod3 (reversed and taped) and all three of them show on the minimized picture as GFmod3-so I was puzzled to found there were more of them).

If you use any of the latter 2 BCM variants, it will not display the new grip hand “gesture” of griping both handguard and grip.

I can’t thank enough Fontaine for his patience with dumdums like me still doing such basic errors.

Let’s hope this helps anyone else!
